assessment.nobel_worthiness: Pd-catalyzed C-N coupling is an enabling method that made arylamines accessible in a general, predictable way and is used daily in pharmaceutical and materials synthesis. Ligand design gave a whole community a transformation it could not previously perform reliably; originality and lasting impact are very high.
assessment.attribution: Buchwald and Hartwig independently developed the catalytic, ligand-controlled general methods; the Kosugi tin-amide precedent was stoichiometric in tin and is better seen as a precursor. A two-person prize is clean, with the precursor question the only credit issue.
assessment.maturity: Multiple decades of independent use, industrial scale-up and mechanistic understanding. The 2010 cross-coupling prize did not cover amination, so recognition is timely and overdue rather than premature.
uncertainties: Committee may regard this as an extension of the 2010 cross-coupling prize.
Whether Kosugi or Migita-type precedents deserve credit is a historical judgment I cannot verify independently.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Surfactant-templated ordered mesoporous silica opened a new class of tunable-pore materials, bridging zeolites and amorphous oxides, and led to MCM-41, SBA-15 and a broad family of mesostructured and mesoporous solids. This is a structural design concept that changed catalysis, adsorption and nanocasting, a field I know well.
assessment.attribution: The Mobil team (Kresge, Beck) made the original discovery; Ryoo extended it to carbon replication and Zhao/Stucky to large-pore SBA-15. Independent earlier Japanese FSM-16 work (Inagaki, Kuroda) complicates priority and a fair three-person configuration is hard. I choose Kresge, Ryoo and Zhao as a compromise, acknowledging that Beck, Stucky or Inagaki have genuine claims.
assessment.maturity: Thirty-plus years of confirmation and extensive structural characterization including electron microscopy and diffraction. Fully mature, though real-world application is more modest than for zeolites.
uncertainties: Priority dispute with the Japanese FSM-16 work.
Four to six strong claimants, so any three-person selection leaves out important contributors.
Industrial impact is smaller than the scientific impact.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Targeted protein degradation reframes small-molecule pharmacology as event-driven rather than occupancy-driven, and the PROTAC concept plus molecular-glue mechanism (cereblon) are now in clinical development. Conceptually original with broad chemical-biology impact.
assessment.attribution: Crews and Deshaies conceived and demonstrated the PROTAC concept; Ciulli delivered the structure-based VHL ligands and mechanism. Handa, Ito and others made the thalidomide-cereblon discovery that underlies glue degraders; this is a compound discovery whose parts may need different recognition, and I cannot cleanly place them in three names.
assessment.maturity: Strong independent replication, many clinical trials, but no approved PROTAC drug as far as I know, so clinical validation is still maturing. Timely but possibly slightly early.
uncertainties: Allocation between PROTAC and molecular-glue/cereblon discoveries.
Clinical outcome not yet established; my knowledge of late-stage trial results may be dated.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Halide perovskite absorbers produced a leap in solar-cell efficiency in a few years, and the material class has links to my interest in structure-property relationships in inorganic framework materials. Impact on energy materials research is enormous.
assessment.attribution: Miyasaka first demonstrated the perovskite sensitized cell; Park produced the solid-state device with stable, higher efficiency; Snaith's meso-superstructured and thin-film planar work was decisive for the efficiency jump. Kanatzidis, Seok and Grätzel also have strong claims, so this is a crowded field.
assessment.maturity: Efficiency is well confirmed, but long-term stability, lead toxicity and commercial viability are not settled, which argues against recognition now. The structural chemistry of defects and degradation is still being worked out.
uncertainties: Operational stability is unresolved.
Crowded attribution, with many credible claimants.
Possibly premature relative to commercial outcome.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Serial femtosecond crystallography at X-ray free-electron lasers determined structures from nanocrystals and micro-crystals, with time-resolved studies of reactions and room-temperature structures. It extends the same logic as my own work, getting structures from crystals too small for conventional methods, and is a real enabling method.
assessment.attribution: Chapman led the proof-of-principle and diffract-before-destroy development; Schlichting led time-resolved and biochemical applications. Fromme (membrane protein crystals) is a major contributor. Hajdu's contribution is foundational, but I am uncertain of his current status, and I did not include him. A fair prize needs more than two or three names.
assessment.maturity: Confirmed at several facilities worldwide, though the number of problems for which it is essential is still limited, and access to XFELs is restricted. Moderate maturity, with the method still evolving.
uncertainties: Dependence on large facilities limits breadth of impact.
Overlap with physics and biology and with synchrotron serial methods.
Attribution of the diffract-before-destroy concept is wider than three names.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Base editing converts single bases without double-strand breaks, a chemistry-driven advance in genome editing with a rapid path into therapeutics. Original and clear in design, built on engineered deaminases.
assessment.attribution: David R. Liu was the leader; Komor and Gaudelli were lead trainees and could be added, and Nishida and Kondo made a parallel Target-AID invention. Since CRISPR was recognized in 2020, a single-laureate prize for Liu would be cleaner, though credit for the independent parallel work is unresolved.
assessment.maturity: Clinical use is emerging, with patients treated, but long-term safety and efficacy are still being established. Probably early rather than late.
uncertainties: Timeliness relative to clinical results.
Whether the committee would consider this chemistry rather than medicine, given CRISPR was recognized in chemistry in 2020.
Parallel Target-AID invention.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Multidimensional heteronuclear NMR and relaxation-dispersion methods allow structure and dynamics determination of large biomolecules in solution, including invisible excited states. It is a technique that enabled a whole community, though Wuthrich was recognized in 2002 for the foundational structure determination.
assessment.attribution: Bax, Clore and Kay led methods for isotopic labeling, triple resonance and TROSY-type or CPMG applications to large proteins; Wagner and Palmer also contributed. Three names are defensible but Wagner and Palmer have solid claims.
assessment.maturity: Decades of confirmation and wide use, though cryo-EM and AlphaFold have lessened the relative prominence of NMR for large structures, and the committee may feel the field was already honored.
uncertainties: Overlap with the 2002 prize.
Competition from cryo-EM and prediction methods may lower perceived impact.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Atomic structure of nitrogenase, including the FeMo cofactor with its interstitial carbide and states trapped in catalysis, addresses how biology reduces N2 and is a central problem in bioinorganic chemistry and structural biology, with rigorous crystallographic evidence.
assessment.attribution: Rees led the crystallographic work and the identification of the central light atom (with Einsle); Seefeldt supplied biochemical and spectroscopic mechanistic work; Dean, Ribbe and others have competing claims. A fair split is difficult.
assessment.maturity: Structure is well established, but the catalytic mechanism and the substrate binding mode are still debated, so interpretation is not yet stable.
uncertainties: Mechanism of N2 reduction remains disputed.
Crystallographic assignment of states at partial occupancy requires careful validation.
Attribution to a broad community.
